card.title: Nintendo Switch Mainboard Annotated Test Points and Connector Pinouts

source.title: Nintendo Switch Mainboard Test Points and Connectors

claims.statement: The mainboard features multiple numbered test point regions and connector pinouts labeled with letters and numbers.
claims.evidence: Red rectangular callouts enclosing numbered points such as 1 through 7 across various sections of the board.

card.caveats: The image shows locations and pin numbering for various connectors and test regions but does not provide voltage or resistance values.
